# Pixel Elevator Panel

A pixel-art elevator panel for floors 1 to 6. Press floor buttons to queue requests; the car moves one floor per second toward the next queued floor, shows the current floor and direction, and opens its doors on arrival.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Features

- Floors 1–6 with labeled, keyboard-accessible buttons
- Queueing of multiple floor requests
- Car moves one floor per second toward the next queued floor
- Current floor and direction (Up / Down / Idle) displayed
- Doors open for 2 seconds on arrival
- Pixel-art styling with a cohesive palette
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Visible hover, focus, and pressed states on controls
- Live region announces floor and direction changes

## Controls

- Click or focus a floor button and press Enter/Space to queue that floor
- Pressing the current floor when idle opens the doors immediately
- Duplicate requests are ignored while queued
